reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, which is more than most brands give me, but I already take magnesium at night at home and have a drawer of half-used bottles. A sachet to go solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need a travel sachet. I'm not paying $30 a month for packaging when the same magnesium costs less in a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing an actual batch report with the real magnesium numbers, and a price close to what I pay for my bottle. Even then I'd need a real reason to take it away from home.
